summary.text: Karen Grindberg is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 41 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Grindberg lists an occupation of Retired.
Family is listed as: Married (Tony); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Grindberg's standing committee assignments as Government and Veterans Affairs and Industry, Business and Labor.
